prompt:
Design a professional, original vector-style TEAM LOGO for a Chinese university engineering team. Team name: "认清熬夜差距". University: "汕头大学". This is a standalone team identity, NOT a wallpaper, NOT a poster and NOT a UI mockup.

Deliver one beautifully finished logo centered on a perfectly clean solid white background, landscape canvas 1536x1024. The logo should occupy the middle of the canvas, with generous white margins around it. Aim for the taste and clarity of a real design studio's final identity presentation. Flat ink, sharply controlled geometry, absolutely no environmental decoration.

Concept: "越夜，越清醒" expressed ONLY through the visual mark, without rendering that phrase. Create a distinctive compact geometric symbol that unifies a bold crescent moon with a rising acceleration slash and an intentional negative-space gap. A thick charcoal crescent sweeps around a sharp ascending orange form. The gap between the two creates the idea of distance and performance; the crescent conveys working late at night. Make these two shapes feel inseparable, balanced and iconic, not an ordinary crescent placed beside a generic arrow. A tiny slit or notch in the charcoal moon should repeat the angle of the orange slash. Limit the symbol to TWO or THREE major solid shapes. Make it extremely recognizable as a small app icon and printable in one color. No thin linework, no outline circle, no stars, no speed-line clutter, no shield, no wings, no bolts around the perimeter, no glow. Optically balanced curves with purposeful sharp cuts.

Palette: very dark graphite #22242B and vivid mandarin orange #F36B32 on white. Saturated and confident. No pastel gray, no pale blue, no purple, no metallic gradient or 3D material. The symbol has solid fills and clean vector-like edges.

Layout: a horizontal logo lockup centered on the page. Place the symbol at the LEFT, roughly one-third of the lockup's width. Place the exact six-character Chinese team name "认清熬夜差距" to its RIGHT, one horizontal line, in beautifully customized bold modern Chinese sans-serif lettering. Lettering in graphite. Small distinctive diagonal cuts in selected strokes may echo the symbol while preserving every Chinese character perfectly. Make the custom lettering carefully proportioned, not generic default text and not extreme futuristic glyphs. Align all characters on a straight baseline, six readable characters, consistent size, deliberate spacing. Under the team name place "汕头大学" in much smaller medium-weight graphite sans-serif, with modest letter spacing. This is the ONLY secondary text.

Text must be rendered EXACTLY: "认清熬夜差距" and "汕头大学". No added English, no acronym, no slogan, no numerals and no watermark. Do not reproduce, invent or replace the university's official crest; this is an original independent team logo identified by the school name.

The final result is a clean, memorable, highly resolved two-color graphic identity, with equal attention to the symbol and the Chinese wordmark. Avoid clipart, overcomplex gaming logos, random symbols, extra circles, orbit lines, fake technical labels, low-opacity illustration and multiple logo alternatives on the same canvas. Show only ONE finished horizontal logo.

Create a distinctive, beautifully designed original mascot TEAM EMBLEM for a Shantou University engineering team whose exact Chinese name is "认清熬夜差距". The name is a humorous way of comparing how late the team works. This should have personality, cleverness and excellent graphic design, not look like generic aggressive esports clipart.

One finished standalone emblem on a pure solid white background, 1536x1024 landscape. Center the complete identity in the canvas with ample white margins. Main mark above, exact team-name wordmark directly below, small school name at the bottom. The emblem should feel compact enough for a sticker, presentation cover and app icon. No mockup, no scene, no decorative frame or other designs.

Main visual: an ORIGINAL "night cat" mascot FACE, drawn using a handful of confident geometric flat shapes. It is a young alert cat with ears shaped like precision-machined triangular tabs, one slightly lowered eyelid giving a witty exhausted-but-still-sharp expression, and the other eye awake and focused. Both eyes are clearly visible and friendly, not furious or threatening. A subtle orange crescent-shaped patch crosses one cheek or ear, naturally integrated into the face rather than a separate moon icon. A small angular white negative-space nose and one tiny asymmetrical mouth communicate dry humor. The thick silhouette is graphite dark, with vivid orange ears or cheek accents and warm white facial cuts. Big simple shapes, strong negative space, no fur detail and no tiny outlines. Avoid looking like an owl, wolf, fox, raccoon or alien. Clearly a CAT, recognizably awake late at night, likable and quietly mischievous. The face is highly original and visually balanced. Do not add a coffee cup, headphones, goggles, tools, moon behind the head, star decorations or any external prop.

Palette: graphite black #22242B, punchy warm orange #F36B32 and white. No gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no metallic surface, no glow. Pure flat vector-style ink shapes with crisp curves and carefully considered corners. An excellent graphic designer should be able to reproduce the mark as a vector with relatively few paths. It must remain clear at small sizes and work as a one-color stamp.

Below the face, place EXACTLY "认清熬夜差距" in ONE HORIZONTAL LINE in bold custom Chinese display lettering, graphite black, with a slightly dynamic forward lean and a few restrained angle cuts that match the cat's ears. SIX readable Chinese characters, correct strokes, do not replace characters or merge them into illegible symbols. The wordmark should have its own designed character without looking like a cheap gaming font. Under it, place EXACTLY "汕头大学" in a small neat medium-weight modern Chinese sans-serif. Nothing else is written.

Avoid a shield, heraldic crest, ring or badge border; the face itself is the emblem. Avoid stock esports marks, angry snarling eyes, huge teeth, random lightning bolts, complex ribbons, red-black aggressive gaming imagery, cute baby-animal stickers, irrelevant English, extra slogans, numbers, watermarks, pale colors and weak sketch outlines. This is an ORIGINAL warm, humorous late-night engineering team identity with bold, polished graphic presence.
